content: LLM NL-to-strategy failure modes (academic, 2026): QuantCode-Bench finds frontier models reach only ~70-76 percent pass rate generating executable algorithmic trading strategies single-turn, rising to 95-98 percent in AGENTIC settings with tool feedback - failures are not syntax but wrong operationalization of trading logic, API misuse, and task-semantic drift. Second failure mode is MODE COLLAPSE - ask for 20 strategies and get ~6 distinct ones dressed differently. Third is financial-data hallucination: plausible but false statistics/earnings/market events, most dangerous when executed without human review. Fourth is action instability - rapid buy-then-sell flipping. Mitigations that appear to work: constrained DSL + validator with error feedback loop (agentic), point-in-time evidence grounding, and audit-grounded claim checking against recorded prompt/trajectory.
